- `report.title`, `report.summary` — report content data

- `section.title` — AI-generated section names (report content)
- Footer legal disclaimer text — legal boilerplate, intentionally not translated
- `formatDate()`, `formatReportType()` — formatting helpers
- `report.htmlContent` — AI-generated report content
